summary: Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Dr. Christopher Kim as Chief Scientific Officer, effective immediately. This is a routine executive appointment, not a forced departure or abrupt change. The filing contains no deal terms, transaction, or special-situation event. It is an ordinary current report under Item 8.01 regarding personnel. The appointment relates to the APITOX program leadership. No advisor, premium, or other financial details are provided. This is not a special situation.
